summary: Raft capsized near Yarmony Rapid on the Upper Colorado River below Radium Hot Springs; Brent Boulter, 56, of Aurora died despite bystander CPR; Thomas Russell, 61, of Littleton missing after raft/ground/drone/Hi-Rail searches between Radium and Two Bridges; third rafter self-rescued; neither victim wore a life jacket
location: Yarmony Rapid, Upper Colorado River below Radium Hot Springs
notes: Date pinned 2024-06-01 (Saturday): story reports the raft flipped "on Saturday", the river was searched "Saturday and Sunday", and "the search continues today"; page "last updated 837 days ago" resolves to Sun 2024-06-02. Russell still unlocated at story time. Incident-focused only.
